verdict.rationale: Modal documents a dedicated sandbox 'Filesystem Access' guide (/docs/guide/sandbox-files), so the product does have its own SDK capability for sandbox files. The pack gives only that page's title, though, so specific read, write, upload and download operations are not shown. The JS/Go example reads a file only through exec of 'cat' on a mounted Volume, which is an adjacent workaround rather than a filesystem API. Missing for 10: documented SDK read/write file methods, explicit upload and download of local files, SDK API reference details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read, write, upload, and download files in the sandbox filesystem via the SDK
